task_title: P4 — OB1_REPO (repo-root override; read by scripts/publish-catalog.sh:71 and scripts/ob1-distribute.sh) is missing from docs/publish-transport.md's operator configuration table and the whole reader corpus
task_criteria: docs/publish-transport.md 'Operator configuration' table carries an OB1_REPO row documenting the default (the script's parent directory) and that OB1_BINARY/OB1_DB defaults resolve from it; verification: grep -c 'OB1_REPO' docs/publish-transport.md -> 1 or more (today: 0), and the row states the same validation/interpolation caveats the table applies to OB1_REMOTE_DIR.

items.criterion: docs/publish-transport.md 'Operator configuration' table carries an OB1_REPO row documenting the default (the script's parent directory) and that OB1_BINARY/OB1_DB defaults resolve from it; verification: grep -c 'OB1_REPO' docs/publish-transport.md -> 1 or more (today: 0), and the row states the same validation/interpolation caveats the table applies to OB1_REMOTE_DIR.
items.detail: docs/publish-transport.md:52 adds `| `OB1_REPO` | parent of the checkout's `scripts/` dir | local repo root that `OB1_BINARY` / `OB1_DB` defaults resolve from; local path only — never sent to the host |` inside the 'Operator configuration' table (header at line 44). `grep -c 'OB1_REPO' docs/publish-transport.md` -> 3 (>=1). Line 53 was also updated to `(`<repo>` = `OB1_REPO`)`. The caveat paragraph at lines 60-67 mirrors the OB1_REMOTE_DIR framing: 'OB1_PUBLISH_BOX, OB1_REMOTE_DIR and OB1_SERVICE are validated ... because they are interpolated into the remote activation body ... `OB1_REPO` stays strictly local — it only feeds the artifact defaults and is not interpolated into the remote body, so it carries no remote-body validation of its own; the artifacts resolved from it still must exist and be non-empty (exit 5).' Verified against code: scripts/publish-catalog.sh:71 `REPO="${OB1_REPO:-$(cd "$HERE/.." && pwd)}"` with HERE=script dir (:50), and :72-73 `BINARY="${OB1_BINARY:-$REPO/off-by-one}"` / `DB="${OB1_DB:-$REPO/off-by-one.db}"`. Empirical: `OB1_PUBLISH_DRY_RUN=1 bash scripts/publish-catalog.sh` prints `binary : /home/kara/worktrees/off-by-one-DOC-17/off-by-one` and `database : .../off-by-one.db` (parent of scripts/). `make transport-retry-selftest` exit_code=0 -> '108/108 checks passed — ALL GREEN'.

items.criterion: The documented OB1_REPO default ("parent of the checkout's scripts/ dir") must match the actual default in scripts/publish-catalog.sh, and the doc must not misstate it for the other reader (scripts/ob1-distribute.sh, whose default is $HOME/off-by-one).
items.detail: scripts/publish-catalog.sh:71 `REPO="${OB1_REPO:-$(cd "$HERE/.." && pwd)}"` with `HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"` at :50 — exactly 'parent of the checkout's scripts/ dir'. Confirmed empirically by the dry-run plan printing the repo root as the binary/DB base. The row is scoped to the publish leg, and OB1_BINARY/OB1_DB are read only by publish-catalog.sh (`grep -rn 'OB1_BINARY|OB1_DB'` -> only publish-catalog.sh:72-73 plus the doc), so it does not misdescribe scripts/ob1-distribute.sh's separate `REPO="${OB1_REPO:-$HOME/off-by-one}"` (:38) / `_ob1_canonical` (:24).

items.criterion: The caveat the doc adds about OB1_REPO (no remote-body validation of its own; artifacts resolved from it must exist and be non-empty, exit 5) must be true of the code, not invented.
items.detail: validate_config() at scripts/publish-catalog.sh:88-125 has cases for MODE, BOX, REMOTE_DIR, SERVICE, HEALTH_PORT only — no OB1_REPO case, so 'carries no remote-body validation of its own' is accurate. Empirically `OB1_REPO="/tmp/a b"` dry-run returns rc=0 (not rejected), whereas a space in OB1_PUBLISH_BOX is rejected (selftest ARM 17 'quote/space injection in box -> rc 5'). The exit-5 claim is require_artifacts() at :127-138 returning EXIT_CONFIG=5 (:59), reached from mode_host() :240; empirically `OB1_REPO=/tmp/nonexistent-repo bash scripts/publish-catalog.sh` -> rc=5, 'config: binary artifact missing or empty: /tmp/nonexistent-repo/off-by-one'. OB1_REPO is never interpolated into the remote heredoc (activate_artifacts_once uses only STAGE_BIN/STAGE_DB/REMOTE_DIR/SERVICE).

items.criterion: The doc change must not break the existing transport self-test / doc-referenced verification (make transport-retry-selftest).
items.detail: `make transport-retry-selftest` exit_code=0, decisive output line: 'transport-retry self-test: 108/108 checks passed — ALL GREEN'. This is the command the doc itself cites under '## Verification'. The change is docs-only (`git show --stat 039a170c` -> `docs/publish-transport.md | 8 ++++++--`, 6 insertions / 2 deletions), so no Go path is touched; the prior tier-1 `go test` run was green (15 pkgs ok).
